exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Which picture shows: car fumes; public transport; a rainforest; a person planting a tree; a hunter; wildlife?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang. Qaysi surat ko'rsatadi: mashina tutuni; jamoat transporti; tropik o'rmon; daraxt ekayotgan odam; ovchi; yovvoyi tabiat?
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SURAT - OLTI TUShUNChA.

  car fumes → 4 (tirband ko'cha)
  public transport → 2 (avtobus)
  a rainforest → 1 (o'rmon)
  a person planting a tree → 6
  a hunter → 5 (miltiq)
  wildlife → 3 (bug'ular)


⚠ 'FUMES':

  = tutun, zaharli gaz.
  ⚠ HAR DOIM ko'plikda.
  ⚠ 'car fumes' = mashina tutuni.


⚠ 'PUBLIC TRANSPORT':

  = jamoat transporti.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'WILDLIFE':

  = yovvoyi tabiat (hayvonlar).
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'PRECIOUS':

  = qimmatli, aziz.
  ⚠ 'Our Precious Planet' - unit
  nomi (68-betdagi muqovada).

exercises.instructionEn: a) What is acid rain? Tick (✓). b) What can cause acid rain? Tick (✓).
exercises.instructionUz: a) Kislotali yomg'ir nima? Belgilang. b) Kislotali yomg'irga nima sabab bo'lishi mumkin? Belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'ACID RAIN':

  = kislotali yomg'ir.
  ⚠ Zavodlar va mashinalar tutunidagi
  kimyoviy moddalar yomg'ir bilan
  tushadi - o'rmon va ko'llarga zarar.
  ⚠ 'acid' o'qilishi /ˈæsɪd/.


⚠ 'CHEMICALS':

  = kimyoviy moddalar.
  ⚠ 'ch' → /k/: /ˈkemɪklz/.


⚠ 'A FACTORY':

  = zavod, fabrika.
  ⚠ Ko'pligi 'factorIES'.

tasks.prompt: b) What can cause acid rain?

exercises.instructionEn: a) Which of the following are endangered species? Tick (✓). b) Why do we call them 'endangered' species?
exercises.instructionUz: a) Quyidagilardan qaysilari yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostidagi turlar? Belgilang. b) Nega ularni 'endangered' turlar deymiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'ENDANGERED SPECIES':

  = yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostidagi
  turlar.
  ⚠ 'endangered' = xavf ostida
  ('en-' + 'danger' + '-ed').
  ⚠ 'species' - birlik = ko'plik.


JAVOB: tigers, lions, seals, rhinos
  ✓ (dogs ✗ - itlar ko'p).


b) Nega 'endangered'?
  Chunki ular soni juda kamaygan va
  butunlay yo'qolib ketishi mumkin
  ('in danger of dying out').


⚠ 'A SEAL':

  = tyulen.
  ⚠ 'seal' = muhr ham.


⚠ 'A RHINO':

  = karkidon ('rhinoceros'
  qisqartmasi).

tasks.prompt: b) Why do we call them 'endangered' species?
tasks.answer: Because they are in danger of dying out completely.
options: Because they are in danger of dying out completely.
Because they are dangerous to people.
tasks.speakAnswer: Because they are in danger of dying out completely.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the problems to the causes, then make sentences using the passive, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Muammolarni sabablarga moslang, so'ng majhul nisbatda gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUAMMO → SABAB:

  endangered species/kill → hunters
    (kitobda strelka bilan)
  air pollution/cause → cars
  rainforests/destroy → logging
    companies

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Endangered species are killed by
   hunters.'


⚠ MAJHUL NISBAT (9-unit):
  are killed BY hunters
  is caused BY cars
  are destroyed BY logging companies


⚠ 'A LOGGING COMPANY':

  = yog'och tayyorlash kompaniyasi
  (daraxt kesadi).
  ⚠ 'a log' = xoda, to'nka.


⚠ BOShQA SABABLAR (savol):

  air pollution → factories,
     aeroplanes
  rainforests → fires, farmers
  endangered species → pollution,
     loss of habitat

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences using the passive, as in the example. Can you think of any other causes of these problems?

exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIP:
  [Muammo] is/are + 3-shakl + by

exercises.instructionEn: The list below includes possible solutions to the problems mentioned above. Use the phrases to make sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatda yuqoridagi muammolarning mumkin bo'lgan yechimlari bor. Iboralardan foydalanib namunalardagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR:

  'If we USED bicycles, we WOULD HAVE
   less air pollution.'
  'If we PLANTED new trees,
   rainforests WOULDN'T DISAPPEAR.'
  'If we CREATED special parks for
   animals, they WOULDN'T be in
   danger.'


⚠ 2-TUR ShART GAPLARI (11-unit
  grammatikasi):

  If + PAST SIMPLE, would + fe'l
  ⚠ XAYoLIY vaziyat (hozir shunday
  emas).
  ⚠ 'If we used bicycles' - hozir
  ishlatmaymiz, lekin AGAR ...


YEChIMLAR:

  use bicycles - velosiped
     ishlatmoq
  plant new trees - yangi daraxt
     ekmoq
  drive electric cars - elektr
     mashina haydamoq
  use less paper - kamroq qog'oz
     ishlatmoq
  create special parks for animals -
     hayvonlar uchun maxsus parklar
     yaratmoq
  teach hunters it's wrong to kill
     animals - ovchilarga hayvon
     o'ldirish noto'g'riligini
     o'rgatmoq


⚠ 'LESS':

  = kamroq (sanalmaydigan bilan).
  ⚠ 'less pollution', 'less paper'.
  ⚠ Sanaladigan bilan 'fewer'.

tasks.answer: If we used bicycles, we would have less air pollution.
tasks.speakAnswer: If we used bicycles, we would have less air pollution.

tasks.answer: If we planted new trees, rainforests wouldn't disappear.
tasks.speakAnswer: If we planted new trees, rainforests wouldn't disappear.

tasks.answer: If we drove electric cars, there would be less air pollution.
tasks.speakAnswer: If we drove electric cars, there would be less air pollution.

tasks.answer: If we used less paper, fewer trees would be cut down.
tasks.speakAnswer: If we used less paper, fewer trees would be cut down.

tasks.answer: If we created special parks for animals, they wouldn't be in danger.
tasks.speakAnswer: If we created special parks for animals, they wouldn't be in danger.

tasks.speakAnswer: If we taught hunters it's wrong to kill animals, endangered species would survive.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the speakers to what each one would do if he/she was leader of his/her country. Write R for Roberta, M for Maria or J for James.
exercises.instructionUz: Gapiruvchilarni har biri o'z mamlakati rahbari bo'lsa nima qilishiga moslang. Roberta uchun R, Maria uchun M, James uchun J yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Audio bor, lekin javoblar 77-BETDAGI
MATNLARDA (5-mashq).

  Roberta (Italiya): 3 ban cars,
     5 improve public transport
  James (Keniya): 2 not allow hunters,
     4 create special parks
  Maria (Braziliya): 1 stop logging
     companies, 6 make them plant
     new trees


OLTI ChORA:

  1 stop logging companies from
    destroying the rainforest
  2 not allow hunters to kill
    endangered species
  3 ban cars
  4 create special parks
  5 improve public transport
  6 make logging companies plant new
    trees

  ⚠ Har gapiruvchi 2 tadan chora
  aytsa kerak (mavzu bo'yicha:
  o'rmon 1+6, hayvonlar 2+4,
  transport 3+5).


⚠ 'IF HE/SHE WAS LEADER':

  2-tur shart: 'If I WAS leader, I
  WOULD ban cars.'
  ⚠ Rasmiy: 'If I WERE leader'.


⚠ 'TO BAN':

  = taqiqlamoq.
  ⚠ 'ban cars' = mashinalarni
  taqiqlamoq.


⚠ 'TO STOP SB FROM DOING':

  = kimnidir ... qilishdan
  to'xtatmoq.


⚠ 'TO MAKE SB DO':

  = majburlamoq ('to' siz).
  'make logging companies PLANT'.

PREDLOGLAR:

  because OF sth
  to live IN a city
  to stop sb FROM doing sth
  an answer TO the problem


⚠ 'BECAUSE' va 'BECAUSE OF':

  because + GAP: 'because they cause
     pollution'
  because OF + OT: 'because of the
     traffic fumes'


⚠ 'AN ANSWER TO':

  = ... ga javob/yechim.
  ⚠ 'answer TO' - 'of' EMAS.

exercises.instructionEn: Read what each person says.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir odam nima deyishini o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh BOLANING FIKRI - TO'LIQ MATN VA
TARJIMA.


⚠ 11-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI - 2-TUR ShART:

  'If I WERE leader, I WOULD ban
   cars.'
  ⚠ 'If I WERE' - rasmiy shakl
  ('was' ham bo'ladi).
  ⚠ Xayoliy vaziyat: ular rahbar
  EMAS.

  'If they DID, our cities WOULD BE
   healthier.'
  'If they DID that, it COULD save
   the rainforest.'


⚠ 'HARDLY':

  = deyarli ... EMAS.
  ⚠ 'I can hardly breathe' = deyarli
  nafas ololmayman.
  ⚠ 'hard' (qattiq) bilan
  ADAShTIRMANG! 'hardly' = 'qattiq'
  EMAS.

tasks.en: Read what each person says.
tasks.uz: Har bir odam nima deyishini o'qing.

tasks.en: [1 Roberta - Italy] If I were leader of my country, I would ban cars because they cause too much air pollution. I hate it when I'm riding my bike in the street and I can hardly breathe because of the traffic fumes. It makes me feel really ill.
tasks.uz: [1 Roberta - Italiya] Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim, chunki ular juda ko'p havo ifloslanishiga sabab bo'ladi. Ko'chada velosiped haydayotganimda transport tutuni tufayli deyarli nafas ololmasligimni yomon ko'raman. Bu meni haqiqatan kasal his qildiradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'If I WERE ... I WOULD ban' - 2-tur shart.
⚠ 'hardly' = deyarli ... emas.
⚠ 'because OF' + ot.

tasks.en: Air pollution causes acid rain, too, which kills trees and plants. I would also improve public transport. People wouldn't need to use their cars so much then. I think people should walk more often, or use a bicycle, like me! If they did, our cities would be healthier places to live in.
tasks.uz: Havo ifloslanishi kislotali yomg'irga ham sabab bo'ladi, u daraxt va o'simliklarni o'ldiradi. Men jamoat transportini ham yaxshilardim. Unda odamlar mashinalarini shunchalik ko'p ishlatishi kerak bo'lmasdi. Menimcha, odamlar men kabi ko'proq piyoda yurishi yoki velosiped ishlatishi kerak! Agar shunday qilsalar, shaharlarimiz yashash uchun sog'lomroq joylar bo'lardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'which kills' - nisbiy olmosh (11-unit).
⚠ 'If they DID, ... WOULD BE' - 2-tur shart.
⚠ 'healthier' = sog'lomroq.

tasks.en: [2 James - Kenya] If I were the leader of my country, I wouldn't allow hunters to kill endangered species. Did you know that animals such as tigers and rhinos have been hunted so much that there will soon be none left?
tasks.uz: [2 James - Keniya] Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, ovchilarga xavf ostidagi turlarni o'ldirishga ruxsat bermasdim. Yo'lbars va karkidon kabi hayvonlar shunchalik ko'p ovlanganki, tez orada birontasi ham qolmasligini bilarmidingiz?
tasks.note:
⚠ 'have been hunted' - present perfect majhul.
⚠ 'none left' = hech biri qolmagan.
⚠ 'such as' = kabi, masalan.

tasks.en: I think we need to teach hunters that it's wrong to kill these animals. I would also create special parks where these animals could live safely.
tasks.uz: Menimcha, biz ovchilarga bu hayvonlarni o'ldirish noto'g'riligini o'rgatishimiz kerak. Men bu hayvonlar xavfsiz yashashi mumkin bo'lgan maxsus parklar ham yaratardim.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'where these animals could live' - nisbiy
olmosh 'where'.
⚠ 'safely' = xavfsiz (ravish).

tasks.en: [3 Maria - Brazil] If I were the leader of my country, I would stop logging companies from destroying the rainforest. It's terrible the way that animals and rare plants die when the trees disappear. Don't these companies know that they're not just destroying the trees and the wildlife? They could destroy us all!
tasks.uz: [3 Maria - Braziliya] Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, yog'och kompaniyalarini tropik o'rmonni vayron qilishdan to'xtatardim. Daraxtlar yo'qolganda hayvonlar va noyob o'simliklar o'lishi dahshatli. Bu kompaniyalar faqat daraxt va yovvoyi tabiatni emas, hammamizni vayron qilishi mumkinligini bilmaydimi?
tasks.note:
⚠ 'stop sb FROM doing' = ... dan to'xtatmoq.
⚠ 'rare' = noyob, kam uchraydigan.
⚠ "Don't these companies know ...?" - inkor
savol (hayrat).

tasks.en: Trees produce oxygen, which is one of our most basic needs. One answer to the problem is to make the logging companies plant new trees. If they did that, it could save the rainforest and give all of us cleaner air to breathe.
tasks.uz: Daraxtlar kislorod ishlab chiqaradi, bu bizning eng asosiy ehtiyojlarimizdan biri. Muammoning bir yechimi - yog'och kompaniyalarini yangi daraxt ekishga majburlash. Agar shunday qilsalar, bu tropik o'rmonni saqlab qolishi va hammamizga nafas olish uchun tozaroq havo berishi mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'oxygen' /ˈɒksɪdʒən/ = kislorod.
⚠ 'basic needs' = asosiy ehtiyojlar.
⚠ 'make sb do' - 'to' siz.
⚠ 'to breathe' /briːð/ = nafas olmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the sentences below and answer the questions which follow. a) "When I am the leader of my country, I will ban cars." b) "If I were the leader of my country, I would ban cars."
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarni o'rganing va keyingi savollarga javob bering. a) "Mamlakatim rahbari bo'lganimda mashinalarni taqiqlayman." b) "Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim."
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GAP - IKKI DUNYo.

  a) 'WHEN I AM ... I WILL' -
     REAL: siyosatchi (u haqiqatan
     rahbar bo'ladi)
  b) 'IF I WERE ... I WOULD' -
     XAYoLIY: bola (rahbar bo'lishi
     ehtimoldan yiroq)


⚠ 'A POLITICIAN':

  = siyosatchi.
  ⚠ 'politics' = siyosat.


⚠ 'UNLIKELY':

  = ehtimoldan yiroq.
  ⚠ 'likely' = ehtimol.
  ⚠ 'highly unlikely' = juda
  ehtimoldan yiroq.

tasks.en: 1 Which sentence was spoken by a child, and which by a politician?
tasks.uz: 1 Qaysi gapni bola, qaysisini siyosatchi aytgan?

tasks.en: 2 Which sentence is about a real or very likely situation in the future?
tasks.uz: 2 Qaysi gap kelajakdagi real yoki juda ehtimolli vaziyat haqida?

tasks.en: 3 Which sentence is about an unreal or highly unlikely situation in the present or future?

tasks.en: 4 How do the two sentences differ in form?

exercises.instructionEn: If ... + past simple + ... would/could/might + bare infinitive
exercises.instructionUz: If ... + o'tgan oddiy zamon + ... would/could/might + 'to' siz fe'l
exercises.explanationUz:
2-TUR ShART GAPLARI - 11-UNITNING
ASOSIY GRAMMATIKASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  IF + PAST SIMPLE,
  WOULD/COULD/MIGHT + FE'L (to siz)

  'If I WERE the leader, I WOULD
   NOT ALLOW hunters ...'
  'If we USED bicycles, there
   WOULDN'T BE so much pollution.'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MA'NOSI                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  XAYoLIY yoki EhTIMOLDAN YIROQ
  vaziyat - HOZIR yoki KELAJAKDA.

  ⚠ 'If I were rich' - men boy
  EMASMAN (xayol).
  ⚠ Past simple bo'lsa ham O'TMISh
  haqida EMAS!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  1-TUR va 2-TUR FARQI            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1-TUR (real):
     If it RAINS, I WILL stay home.
     (yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin)
  2-TUR (xayoliy):
     If it RAINED in the desert,
     plants WOULD grow.
     (cho'lda yomg'ir - ehtimoldan
      yiroq)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'WERE' - HAMMA ShAXSDA          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'If I WERE you ...'
  'If he WERE rich ...'
  ⚠ 'was' ham to'g'ri (so'zlashuv),
  lekin 'were' rasmiy va odatiy.
  ⚠ 'If I were you, I would ...' =
  sening o'rningda bo'lsam - MASLAHAT
  qolipi!


⚠ 'BARE INFINITIVE':

  = 'to' siz infinitiv (fe'lning
  asosiy shakli).
  ⚠ 'would TO ban' - XATO!


⚠ QISQARTMALAR:

  I'd = I would; wouldn't = would
  not.

tasks.en: If ... + past simple + ... would/could/might + bare infinitive

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences using the prompts, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  "If we all USED bicycles, there
   WOULDN'T BE so much air
   pollution."


TO'LIQ JAVOBLAR:

  2 If there WERE more bins in towns
    and cities, there WOULDN'T BE so
    much litter on our streets.
  3 If we DIDN'T POLLUTE lakes and
    rivers, we WOULD HAVE clean
    drinking water.
  4 If we RECYCLED all of our waste,
    rubbish WOULDN'T POLLUTE the
    environment.
  5 If we STOPPED cutting down
    rainforests, FEWER plants and
    animals WOULD DIE.


⚠ 'THERE WERE':

  'If there WERE more bins' - 'there
  is' ning past simple shakli.


⚠ 'LITTER':

  = axlat (ko'chada tashlangan).
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'to drop litter' = axlat tashlamoq.


⚠ 'A BIN':

  = axlat qutisi.


⚠ 'TO RECYCLE':

  = qayta ishlamoq.
  ⚠ 'recycling' = qayta ishlash.


⚠ 'WASTE':

  = chiqindi.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'rubbish' = axlat (Britaniya).


⚠ 'FEWER':

  = kamroq (SANALADIGAN bilan).
  ⚠ 'fewer plants and animals'.
  ⚠ 'less' - sanalmaydigan bilan.

tasks.en: If we all used bicycles, there wouldn't be so much air pollution.
tasks.uz: Agar hammamiz velosiped ishlatsak, havo ifloslanishi shunchalik ko'p bo'lmasdi.

tasks.en: If there were more bins in towns and cities, there wouldn't be so much litter on our streets.
tasks.uz: Agar shahar va qishloqlarda ko'proq axlat qutisi bo'lsa, ko'chalarimizda shunchalik ko'p axlat bo'lmasdi.

tasks.en: If we didn't pollute lakes and rivers, we would have clean drinking water.
tasks.uz: Agar ko'l va daryolarni ifloslantirmasak, toza ichimlik suvimiz bo'lardi.

tasks.en: If we recycled all of our waste, rubbish wouldn't pollute the environment.
tasks.uz: Agar barcha chiqindilarimizni qayta ishlasak, axlat atrof-muhitni ifloslantirmasdi.

tasks.en: If we stopped cutting down rainforests, fewer plants and animals would die.
tasks.uz: Agar tropik o'rmonlarni kesishni to'xtatsak, kamroq o'simlik va hayvon o'lardi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri shaklga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOIDA:
  'if' bo'lagida → PAST SIMPLE
  asosiy gapda → WOULD + fe'l


JAVOBLAR:

  1 If you TOOK your bicycle ...
  2 ... he WOULD BE happier.
  3 If we ASKED her ...
  4 If people DIDN'T DROP litter ...
  5 If you WENT there by bus ...
  6 If people STOPPED using
    aerosols ...
  7 ... they WOULDN'T BE an
    endangered species.
  8 If Veronica WALKED to work ...
  9 If people DIDN'T USE so much
    paper ...
  10 ... there WOULD BE fewer cars.


⚠ QAYSI BO'LAK?

  'If' dan keyin → past simple
  (took, asked, went, ...)
  'If' siz bo'lak → would (would be)


⚠ 'AN AEROSOL':

  = aerozol (sprey).
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈeərəsɒl/.


⚠ 'UNFIT':

  = sog'lom emas, jismonan zaif.
  ⚠ 'fit' = sog'lom, chiniqqan.


⚠ 'TO SHARE A CAR':

  = mashinada birga yurmoq
  (car-sharing).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts in Ex. 5 again and make notes under the following headings for each person. Use your notes to talk about each child's opinion: Measures - Reasons - Results
exercises.instructionUz: 5-mashqdagi matnlarni qayta o'qing va har bir odam uchun quyidagi sarlavhalar ostida qayd oling. Qaydlaringizdan foydalanib har bir bolaning fikri haqida gapiring: Choralar - Sabablar - Natijalar
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR:

  ROBERTA:
    Measures: ban cars, improve public
      transport
    Reasons: air pollution, can't
      breathe, acid rain
    Results: healthier cities

  JAMES:
    Measures: not allow hunters,
      create special parks
    Reasons: tigers and rhinos hunted,
      soon none left
    Results: animals live safely

  MARIA:
    Measures: stop logging companies,
      make them plant trees
    Reasons: animals and rare plants
      die, trees produce oxygen
    Results: save rainforest, cleaner
      air


⚠ 'A MEASURE':

  = chora, tadbir.
  ⚠ 'to take measures' = chora
  ko'rmoq.

tasks.en: Roberta would ban cars and improve public transport because cars cause air pollution and acid rain. As a result, cities would be healthier.
tasks.uz: Roberta mashinalarni taqiqlab, jamoat transportini yaxshilardi, chunki mashinalar havo ifloslanishi va kislotali yomg'irga sabab bo'ladi. Natijada shaharlar sog'lomroq bo'lardi.

tasks.en: James wouldn't allow hunters to kill endangered species and would create special parks because tigers and rhinos have been hunted so much that there will soon be none left. As a result, animals could live safely.
tasks.uz: James ovchilarga xavf ostidagi turlarni o'ldirishga ruxsat bermasdi va maxsus parklar yaratardi, chunki yo'lbars va karkidonlar shunchalik ko'p ovlanganki, tez orada birontasi qolmaydi. Natijada hayvonlar xavfsiz yashay olardi.

tasks.en: Maria would stop logging companies from destroying the rainforest and make them plant new trees because animals and rare plants die when trees disappear and trees produce oxygen. As a result, the rainforest would be saved and we would have cleaner air.
tasks.uz: Maria yog'och kompaniyalarini o'rmonni vayron qilishdan to'xtatib, ularni yangi daraxt ekishga majburlardi, chunki daraxtlar yo'qolganda hayvonlar va noyob o'simliklar o'ladi va daraxtlar kislorod ishlab chiqaradi. Natijada tropik o'rmon saqlanib qolardi va havomiz tozaroq bo'lardi.

sentencePatterns.formula: If we + PAST SIMPLE, we would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If we used bicycles, we would have less air pollution.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar velosiped ishlatsak, havo ifloslanishi kamroq bo'lardi.

sentencePatterns.formula: If I was leader of my country, I would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I was leader of my country, I would ban cars.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: If I were leader of my country, I would / wouldn't + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I were leader of my country, I would ban cars.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: I can hardly + FE'L because of [ot].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can hardly breathe because of the traffic fumes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Transport tutuni tufayli deyarli nafas ololmayman.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I would stop logging companies from destroying the rainforest.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yog'och kompaniyalarini o'rmonni vayron qilishdan to'xtatardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: One answer to the problem is to make [kim] + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: One answer to the problem is to make the logging companies plant new trees.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Muammoning bir yechimi - yog'och kompaniyalarini yangi daraxt ekishga majburlash.

sentencePatterns.formula: If + ega + PAST SIMPLE, ega + would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If we all used bicycles, there wouldn't be so much air pollution.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar hammamiz velosiped ishlatsak, havo ifloslanishi shunchalik ko'p bo'lmasdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: If I were [kim], I would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I were the leader of my country, I would ban cars.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: If there were [nima], there wouldn't be [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If there were more bins, there wouldn't be so much litter.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar ko'proq axlat qutisi bo'lsa, shunchalik ko'p axlat bo'lmasdi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When I am the leader of my country, I will ban cars.
